en.event: National Emergency proclaimed on external aggression, during the war with China.

en.event: Second proclamation, on external aggression, during the war with Pakistan.

hi.event: पाकिस्तान के साथ युद्ध के दौरान, बाहरी आक्रमण के आधार पर दूसरी बार घोषणा हुई।

en.event: June: proclaimed on 'internal disturbance'; the 1971 proclamation was still in force.

en.event: The 44th Amendment replaced 'internal disturbance' with 'armed rebellion' as a ground.

takeaway.en: All three used Article 352, on different grounds. The 1975 one was on internal disturbance; in 1978 that ground changed to armed rebellion.
takeaway.hi: तीनों घोषणाएँ अनुच्छेद 352 के तहत थीं, पर आधार अलग थे। 1975 की घोषणा 'आंतरिक अशांति' के आधार पर थी; 1978 में इस आधार की जगह 'सशस्त्र विद्रोह' आया।

memoryHook.en: Remember: 62 and 71 were wars with outsiders; 75 was the one at home, on internal disturbance.
memoryHook.hi: याद रखें: 62 और 71 बाहरी युद्धों वाले, 75 घर के भीतर की 'आंतरिक अशांति' वाली।
